lines.en: I drag myself along, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下黏液。
lines.en: Slime trails behind where I pass.
My guts swing outside my body.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边渗出东西。
lines.en: I ooze as I walk.
I creep slowly toward you.
Each shift of mine sags a little.
My hooves scrape the ground.
I move over; the smell arrives first.
I round a stone, very slowly.
No hurry; I rot slowly.
My hide splits as I move.
Flies follow wherever I go.
I lie there, my belly rising and falling.
I reek, motionless.
I wait for zombies to come and break me.
My one rotten eye half opens, half closes.
My chest cavity caved in long ago.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西慢慢流出来。
lines.en: Things slowly leak out of me.

lines.zh: 我只是一具烂掉的尸体。
lines.en: I am just a rotted carcass.

lines.zh: 风把我的味道吹向远处。
lines.en: The wind carries my stench away.

lines.zh: 我动了一下耳朵，又不动了。
lines.en: My ear twitches, then stops.
I rot in peace.
I lift half a face to you.
There is no eye in my socket.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，脖子响了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my neck cracks.

lines.zh: 你的热气烫着我的鼻孔。
lines.en: Your body heat stings my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，嘴里流出口水。
lines.en: I stare, drooling.
I turn toward you, slowly.
My nostrils twitch twice.
I know the smell of the living.
My throat works once.

lines.zh: 我用没烂的那只眼看你。
lines.en: I look at you with my unrotted eye.

lines.zh: 又一块腐肉从我身上滑落。
lines.en: Another chunk of rotten flesh slides off me.
I slowly press myself together.

lines.zh: 我流出一滩更臭的东西。
lines.en: A fouler puddle leaks out.
My sound cuts off.

lines.zh: 我的脊背又塌下去一截。
lines.en: My spine sags another notch.
Bone shows through my hide.
The pain comes slowly.
I shift away and hide.

lines.zh: 我身上的苍蝇飞起来一片。
lines.en: A cloud of flies lifts off me.
I let out a long groan.
I smell it and stir.
Rotten flesh still counts as a meal.
I crawl toward that thing.
I snap at empty air.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，很慢地流口水。
lines.en: I stare and drool slowly.
I press my nose to the ground.
I drag it under my body.

lines.zh: 那味道让我想起活着的时候。
lines.en: The smell recalls when I was alive.
I cannot chew, and I still want it.
I shift half a block that way.
You step on me and I give way.
A dent sinks into my body.
Slime sticks to your boots.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子勾住了你的脚。
lines.en: My hoof hooks around your foot.
My bones knock against your foot.
I shift aside a little, slowly.
You pull away; the stench remains.
My hide clings to your trouser leg.
Our collision makes a wet sound.
I am not pushed far.

lines.zh: 我们并排躺着，渗到一起。
lines.en: We lie side by side, oozing together.
It shifts over and leans on me.
Our stenchs blend into one.

lines.zh: 我们一起慢慢蠕了一下。
lines.en: We squirm once, slowly, together.

lines.zh: 它的骨头碰到我的骨头。
lines.en: Its bones knock against mine.
Neither of us moves again.
We heap in the same hollow.
Our slime joins into one patch.
I touch it with my nose.

lines.zh: 我们一起发出很轻的哼声。
lines.en: We let out a soft groan together.

lines.zh: 我压住那东西，慢慢裹起来。
lines.en: I press the thing down and slowly wrap it.
I swallow it into my belly.
I hold it and cannot move.
I pick it up in my teeth.
It sinks into my flesh.

lines.zh: 我把它压在自己的身下。
lines.en: I press it beneath me.

lines.zh: 我舔了一下，就收起来了。
lines.en: I lick it once and tuck it away.
I carry it beside my guts.
I drag it two blocks.

lines.zh: 它被我身上的黏液黏住了。
lines.en: My slime glues it to me.
I raise my head; I have the scent.
I drag my guts around to face you.
My teeth show.
Something living is near.
Zombies will follow me to you.
I slowly prop up my front.
I aim my ruined face at you.
I begin moving your way.
A wet sound squeezes out of my throat.
The air here has turned foul.

lines.zh: 我找到了它该去的地方。
lines.en: I have found where it belongs.

lines.zh: 我的心口跳了一下，假的。
lines.en: My chest thumps once, falsely.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己转了个方向。
lines.en: I drag myself around to face it.

lines.zh: 我认出了会喘气的东西。
lines.en: I recognize something that breathes.
I start to call, muffled.
I creep after you, bit by bit.
You take a step; I crawl half a block.

lines.zh: 我的黏液在身后留下线。
lines.en: My slime leaves a line behind.
I am not fast, but I do not stop.
I am leading them here.
Do you hear all those footsteps?
I spread the stench your way.
You skirt me; I turn to you again.
My body comes apart as it crawls.

lines.zh: 僵尸在我后面聚起来了。
lines.en: Zombies are gathering behind me.
I keep rotting near you.
I have shifted behind you.

lines.zh: 你退到坡上，我也往上爬。
lines.en: You back up the slope; I crawl up too.

lines.zh: 我的眼里映着你的影子。
lines.en: Your shadow reflects in my eye.
I crawl along your footprints.
The moment your steps stop, so do I.
Only one block between us now.
I am waiting for them to surround you.
My teeth close on your calf.
I butt you with my ruined forehead.
I press onto you, heavy and wet.
My hoof catches your knee.
I spit out something thick.
My teeth stay clamped after biting.
My stench makes you gag.
My limp hand slaps your leg.
I latch onto your ankle.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在你身上留下痕。
lines.en: My bones leave a mark on you.
You shake me off; I keep crawling.
It is not heavy, but you cannot wash it off.
Half a tooth of mine breaks off.
I knock you back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的黏液粘在你的护甲缝里。
lines.en: My slime gets into your armor seams.
I bite, then slowly let go.

lines.zh: 地上多了一具烂掉的尸体。
lines.en: A rotted carcass lies on the ground.
The stench arrives first, then I do.
There were no flies here before.
I begin rotting at your feet.
A heap slowly gathers itself.
You hear a muffled groan.
A rotted pig lies in the grass.
The air suddenly grows thick.

lines.zh: 我的肠子先摊开，然后是我。
lines.en: My guts spread out first, then the rest.
This ground starts to stink.
I am pushed up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 有东西在你身后开始呼吸不顺畅。
lines.en: Something behind you starts breathing badly.

lines.zh: 我趴在那儿，像死了很久。
lines.en: I lie there as if long dead.
The flies circle me once.

lines.zh: 火把我身上的油烧得噼啪响。
lines.en: The fire crackles on my greasy hide.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，摊成一团。
lines.en: I fall from a height and splatter.

lines.zh: 水把我泡胀了，我浮起来。
lines.en: Water bloats me and I float up.
The blast tears me into pieces.

lines.zh: 箭头扎进我身上，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow buries in me and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那股力量烧掉了我身上的腐气。
lines.en: That force burns the rot out of me.
Hunger stops me from crawling at all.
Lightning scorches a layer off me.

lines.zh: 下面的地没了，我一路散落下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I scatter downward.
